IC1: - Diagnosed diabetes mellitus [AND] and treatment-[NOT] naïve CI-DME requiring anti-VEGF therapy per retinal specialist's customary treatment regimen will be recruited to participate in the study. CI-DME will be defined as a central subfield thickness (CST) [OR] > 300 microns on spectral domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT) or CST [AND] > 250 microns with definite intra-retinal cystic fluid accumulation. Additional inclusion criteria are age > 18 years, and ability to give informed consent.
